abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the potential of manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD) as a tumor marker for seminoma. MATERIALS: A total of 44 patients with testicular germ cell tumors were assessed for serum and tissue levels of MnSOD in comparison with levels of placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP). RESULTS: Positive rates of serum MnSOD were 11% for stage I, 25% for stage II and 80% for stage III. No difference was observed in serum MnSOD between seminoma and NSGCT. No difference was demonstrated in tissue MnSOD level between seminoma and NSGCT, or between tumors and their normal counterparts. CONCLUSION: Since serum MnSOD was shown to have lower sensitivity than PLAP, and MnSOD concentration did not differ significantly between tumors and their normal counterparts, the role of MnSOD as a marker for seminoma appears to be limited.
abstract_ja: 目的:セミノーマの腫瘍マーカーとしての可能性を、マンガンスーパーオキシドジスムターゼ(MnSOD)について検討すること。対象:精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者44例において、血清および組織中のMnSODレベルを胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)と比較した。結果:血清MnSOD陽性率は病期Iで11%、病期IIで25%、病期IIIで80%であった。血清MnSODはセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍との間で差がなかった。組織MnSODレベルもセミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍との間、あるいは腫瘍と正常組織との間で有意差はなかった。結論:血清MnSODはPLAPより感度が低く、腫瘍と正常組織の濃度に有意差がないため、セミノーマのマーカーとしての役割は限定的と思われる。
